en:
SDcard

Introduction

The sdcard class is derived from the brain base class and provides access to files stored on a removable SD card inserted into the V5 Brain.

Using the SD card, your robot can load data such as images, read and write files, and store information for later use or transfer to a computer.

Access

Brain.SDcard

Notes

  • The V5 Brain supports SD cards up to 32GB in size.
  • The SD card must be formatted as FAT32.
    • SD cards larger than 32GB are typically formatted as exFAT, which is not compatible with the V5 Brain.
  • All files must be placed in the root directory of the SD card to be accessible.
  • The SD card must be inserted into the Brain before file operations can be performed.
  • File names and paths are case-sensitive.

Example

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
A Brain is generated automatically at the start of
VEXcode projects. */

// Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain();

// Add more text and display file size
if (Brain.SDcard.exists("Text.txt")) {
  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
}

Member Functions

The sdcard class includes the following member functions:

  • loadfile — Loads the contents of a file from the SD card into a user-provided memory buffer.
  • savefile — Saves data from a user-provided buffer to a file on the V5 Brain’s SD card.
  • appendfile — Appends data from a user-provided buffer to the end of an existing file on the V5 Brain’s SD card.
  • isInserted — Returns whether an SD card is inserted into the Brain.
  • size — Returns the size of a file stored on the V5 Brain’s SD card.
  • exists — Returns whether a file with the specified name exists on the V5 Brain’s SD card.

.bmp and .png files stored on the SD card can be displayed on the V5 Brain screen using drawImageFromFile, which is accessed through Brain.Screen.

Before calling any sdcard member functions, a brain instance must be created, as shown below:

// Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain();

loadfile

Loads the contents of a file from the SD card into a user-provided memory buffer.

Available Functions

int32_t loadfile(
  const char* name,
  uint8_t* buffer,
  int32_t len );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
name const char* The name of the file to load from the SD card. The file's name must include the file extension.
buffer uint8_t* A pointer to a buffer where the file data will be stored.
len int32_t The maximum number of bytes to read from the file, typically set to the size of the buffer.

Return Values

Returns an int32_t representing the number of bytes successfully read from the file:

  • A positive value indicates how many bytes were loaded into the buffer.

  • 0 indicates that no data was read.

    Notes

  • If the file is larger than len, only the first len bytes are read.

  • The buffer must be large enough to hold the requested data.

  • This function reads raw bytes and does not append a null terminator.

    Examples

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
}

savefile

Saves data from a user-provided buffer to a file on the V5 Brain’s SD card.

Available Functions

int32_t savefile(
  const char* name,
  uint8_t* buffer,
  int32_t len );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
name const char* The name of the file to save as a string. The file's name must include the file extension.
buffer uint8_t* A pointer to a memory buffer containing the data to be written to the file.
len int32_t The number of bytes to write from the buffer to the file.

Return Values

Returns an int32_t representing the number of bytes successfully written to the file:

  • A positive value indicates how many bytes were saved.

  • 0 indicates that no data was written.

    Notes

  • If the file is larger than len, only the first len bytes are read.

  • If a file with the same name already exists, it will be overwritten.

  • This function does not allocate memory; the buffer must be created and managed by the user.

  • The function writes raw bytes and does not append a null terminator.

    Examples

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
}

appendfile

Appends data from a user-provided buffer to the end of an existing file on the V5 Brain’s SD card.

Available Functions

int32_t appendfile(
  const char* name,
  uint8_t* buffer,
  int32_t len );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
name const char* The name of the file to append data to on the SD card. The file's name must include the file extension.
buffer uint8_t* A pointer to a memory buffer containing the data to be appended to the file.
len int32_t The number of bytes to append from the buffer to the file.

Return Values

Returns an int32_t representing the number of bytes successfully appended to the file:

  • A positive value indicates how many bytes were appended.

  • 0 indicates that no data was appended.

    Notes

  • If the file is larger than len, only the first len bytes are read.

  • The file must already exist on the SD card; this function does not create a new file.

  • This function does not allocate memory; the buffer must be created and managed by the user.

  • The function appends raw bytes and does not append a null terminator.

    Examples

// Create a message to save to a new file
uint8_t message[] = "Hello";

// Save only the characters, not the null terminator
Brain.SDcard.savefile("Message.txt", message, sizeof(message) - 1);

// Load the file
int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Message.txt");
uint8_t buffer[fileSize + 1];
Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Message.txt", buffer, fileSize);

// Add null terminator so it can be printed safely
buffer[fileSize] = 0;
Brain.Screen.print("%s\n", buffer);

// Create more text to append to the same file
uint8_t moreText[] = " World!";

// Append only the characters, not the null terminator
Brain.SDcard.appendfile("Message.txt", moreText, sizeof(moreText) - 1);

// Load the updated file
fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Message.txt");
uint8_t buffer2[fileSize + 1];
Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Message.txt", buffer2, fileSize);

// Add null terminator
buffer2[fileSize] = 0;
Brain.Screen.newLine();
Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer2);

isInserted

Returns whether an SD card is currently inserted in the V5 Brain.

Available Functions

bool isInserted();

Parameters

This function does not accept any parameters.

Return Values

Returns a Boolean indicating whether an SD card is inserted:

  • true — An SD card is inserted in the V5 Brain.

  • false — No SD card is inserted.

    Notes

  • This function only checks for the presence of an SD card; it does not verify that the card is formatted or readable.

    Examples

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
  }

size

Returns the size of a file stored on the V5 Brain’s SD card.

Available Functions

int32_t size(
  const char* name );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
name const char* The name of the file on the SD card. The file's name must include the file extension.

Return Values

Returns an int32_t representing the size of the file in bytes:

  • A positive value indicates the file size in bytes.

  • 0 indicates an empty file or that the file could not be found.

    Notes

  • The returned size can be used to allocate a buffer before calling loadfile.

    Examples

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
}

exists

Returns whether a file with the specified name exists on the V5 Brain’s SD card.

Available Functions

bool exists(
  const char* name );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
name const char* The name of the file to check on the SD card. The file's name must include the file extension.

Return Values

Returns a Boolean indicating whether the file exists:

  • true — A file with the specified name exists on the SD card.

  • false — No file with the specified name exists.

    Examples

// Add more text and display file size
if (Brain.SDcard.exists("Text.txt")) {
  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
}
zh:
SD 卡

概述

sdcard类派生自brain基类，并提供对插入 V5 主控器的可移动 SD 卡上存储的文件的访问。

使用 SD 卡，您的机器人可以加载图像等数据、读取和写入文件以及存储信息以供以后使用或传输到计算机。

访问

Brain.SDcard

说明与注意事项

  • V5主控器支持最大32GB的SD卡。
  • SD 卡必须格式化为 FAT32。
    • 大于32GB的SD卡一般格式化为exFAT，与V5主控器不兼容。
  • 所有文件必须放置在SD卡的根目录下才能访问。
  • 必须将SD卡插入主控器后才能进行文件操作。
  • 文件名和路径区分大小写。

示例

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
A Brain is generated automatically at the start of
VEXcode projects. */

// Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain();

// Add more text and display file size
if (Brain.SDcard.exists("Text.txt")) {
  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
}

成员函数

sdcard类包含以下成员函数：

  • loadfile— 将文件内容从 SD 卡加载到用户提供的内存缓冲区中。
  • savefile— 将用户提供的缓冲区中的数据保存到 V5 主控器 SD 卡上的文件中。
  • appendfile— 将用户提供的缓冲区中的数据附加到 V5 主控器 SD 卡上现有文件的末尾。
  • isInserted— 返回主控制器是否插入SD卡。
  • size— 返回 V5 主控器 SD 卡上存储的文件大小。
  • exists— 返回V5主控制器的SD卡上是否存在指定名称的文件。

SD卡上存储的.bmp和.png文件可以通过drawImageFromFile在V5主控器屏幕上显示，通过Brain.Screen访问。

在调用任何sdcard成员函数之前，必须创建一个brain实例，如下所示：

// Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain();

loadfile

将文件内容从 SD 卡加载到用户提供的内存缓冲区中。

函数重载

int32_t loadfile(
  const char* name,
  uint8_t* buffer,
  int32_t len );

参数

参数 类型 说明
name const char* 要从 SD 卡加载的文件的名称。文件名必须包含文件扩展名。
buffer uint8_t* 指向将存储文件数据的缓冲区的指针。
len int32_t 从文件读取的最大字节数，通常设置为缓冲区的大小。

返回值

返回一个int32_t表示从文件中成功读取的字节数：

  • 正值表示已将多少字节加载到缓冲区中。

  • 0表示没有读取到数据。

    备注

  • 如果文件大于len，则仅读取前len字节。

  • 缓冲区必须足够大才能容纳请求的数据。

  • 该函数读取原始字节并且不附加空终止符。

    示例

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
}

savefile

将用户提供的缓冲区中的数据保存到 V5 主控器 SD 卡上的文件中。

函数重载

int32_t savefile(
  const char* name,
  uint8_t* buffer,
  int32_t len );

参数

参数 类型 说明
name const char* 要保存为字符串的文件的名称。文件名必须包含文件扩展名。
buffer uint8_t* 指向包含要写入文件的数据的内存缓冲区的指针。
len int32_t 从缓冲区写入文件的字节数。

返回值

返回一个int32_t表示成功写入文件的字节数：

  • 正值表示保存了多少字节。

  • 0表示没有写入数据。

    备注

  • 如果文件大于len，则仅读取前len字节。

  • 如果已存在同名文件，则覆盖该文件。

  • 该函数不分配内存；缓冲区必须由用户创建和管理。

  • 该函数写入原始字节并且不附加空终止符。

    示例

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
}

appendfile

将用户提供的缓冲区中的数据附加到 V5 主控器 SD 卡上现有文件的末尾。

函数重载

int32_t appendfile(
  const char* name,
  uint8_t* buffer,
  int32_t len );

参数

参数 类型 说明
name const char* SD 卡上要附加数据的文件的名称。文件名必须包含文件扩展名。
buffer uint8_t* 指向包含要附加到文件的数据的内存缓冲区的指针。
len int32_t 从缓冲区附加到文件的字节数。

返回值

返回一个int32_t表示成功附加到文件的字节数：

  • 正值表示附加了多少字节。

  • 0表示没有附加数据。

    备注

  • 如果文件大于len，则仅读取前len字节。

  • 文件必须已存在于SD卡上；该函数不会创建新文件。

  • 该函数不分配内存；缓冲区必须由用户创建和管理。

  • 该函数附加原始字节，但不附加空终止符。

    示例

// Create a message to save to a new file
uint8_t message[] = "Hello";

// Save only the characters, not the null terminator
Brain.SDcard.savefile("Message.txt", message, sizeof(message) - 1);

// Load the file
int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Message.txt");
uint8_t buffer[fileSize + 1];
Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Message.txt", buffer, fileSize);

// Add null terminator so it can be printed safely
buffer[fileSize] = 0;
Brain.Screen.print("%s\n", buffer);

// Create more text to append to the same file
uint8_t moreText[] = " World!";

// Append only the characters, not the null terminator
Brain.SDcard.appendfile("Message.txt", moreText, sizeof(moreText) - 1);

// Load the updated file
fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Message.txt");
uint8_t buffer2[fileSize + 1];
Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Message.txt", buffer2, fileSize);

// Add null terminator
buffer2[fileSize] = 0;
Brain.Screen.newLine();
Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer2);

isInserted

返回V5主控制器当前是否插入SD卡。

函数重载

bool isInserted();

参数

该函数不接受任何参数。

返回值

返回一个布尔指示是否插入了SD卡：

  • true— V5主控器中插入SD卡。

  • false— 未插入 SD 卡。

    备注

  • 该函数仅检查 SD 卡是否存在；它不验证卡是否已格式化或可读。

    示例

// Check for SD card and show a file's text
if (Brain.SDcard.isInserted()) {
  // Create a message to save to the SD card
  uint8_t message[] = "Hello from VEX!";

  // Save the message into "Text.txt"
  Brain.SDcard.savefile("Text.txt", message, sizeof(message));

  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
  }

size

返回V5主控器SD卡上存储的文件大小。

函数重载

int32_t size(
  const char* name );

参数

参数 类型 说明
name const char* SD 卡上的文件的名称。文件名必须包含文件扩展名。

返回值

返回一个int32_t表示文件大小（以字节为单位）：

  • 正值表示文件大小（以字节为单位）。

  • 0表示空文件或找不到该文件。

    备注

  • 返回的大小可用于在调用loadfile之前分配缓冲区。

    示例

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];

  // Load the file from the SD card into the buffer
  Brain.SDcard.loadfile("Text.txt", buffer, sizeof(buffer));

  // Display the file contents on the screen
  Brain.Screen.print("%s", buffer);
} else {
  Brain.Screen.print("Insert SD card");
}

exists

返回V5主控器SD卡上是否存在指定名称的文件。

函数重载

bool exists(
  const char* name );

参数

参数 类型 说明
name const char* SD 卡上要检查的文件的名称。文件名必须包含文件扩展名。

返回值

返回一个 布尔 指示文件是否存在：

  • true— SD 卡上存在指定名称的文件。

  • false— 不存在具有指定名称的文件。

    示例

// Add more text and display file size
if (Brain.SDcard.exists("Text.txt")) {
  // Get the size of the file
  int fileSize = Brain.SDcard.size("Text.txt");

  // Make a buffer to hold the file data
  uint8_t buffer[fileSize];
